detections.summary: Speakers explain plasma exchange/apheresis, its clinical uses for autoimmune disease and drug overdoses, the risk of removing good plasma components, how the body regenerates them, and the guest's own positive experience after treatment.

detections.evidence_quote: general theory emerging about aging called immunofatigue
detections.summary: The hosts discuss the 'immunofatigue' / immunosenescence theory that progressive overloading of the immune system drives aging.

detections.evidence_quote: there's 150,000 toxins in our environment that were never there just eight decades ago
detections.summary: Speakers describe a huge burden of environmental toxins in food, air and water and ask what helps the body eliminate them.

detections.evidence_quote: People were coming even with like overdose of certain medications, and they would be in the plasma and they would die unless they got the apheresis done
detections.summary: The physician-speaker draws on his residency and emergency-room experience to describe plasma exchange for medication overdoses.

detections.evidence_quote: I felt like I'd taken a limitless pill
detections.summary: The guest describes his own post-plasma-exchange experience of alertness, calm and improved appearance as a testimonial.

detections.evidence_quote: I've talked to Dr. Peter Diamandis and a lot of leading minds in in longevity medicine
detections.summary: The guest cites Dr. Peter Diamandis and 'leading minds in longevity medicine' as authorities for the emerging theory.

detections.evidence_quote: anything that's living in your plasma that is toxic to your system can be removed with this machine
detections.summary: The speaker explains the mechanism by which plasma exchange removes toxins from plasma.

detections.evidence_quote: your body is so incredibly good at regenerating those, mostly within twenty four hours
detections.summary: The speaker explains how the body regenerates plasma components removed by the exchange, with immunoglobulins taking longer and IVIG for at-risk patients.

detections.evidence_quote: there's 150,000 toxins in our environment that were never there just eight decades ago
detections.summary: Health is framed around an overwhelming burden of environmental toxins.

detections.evidence_quote: The FDA lets them all go in our food supply
detections.summary: The FDA is portrayed as allowing toxins into the food supply.

verification_candidates.claim_text: When a vial of blood is spun in a centrifuge, it separates into red cells at the bottom and plasma, the liquid portion, at the top (about 45 percent).
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it separates into the red cells at the bottom and the top part, the forty-five percent is plasma—that's the liquid portion
verification_candidates.rationale: A basic factual claim about blood composition and centrifugation that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Autoimmune diseases build up immune complexes that are toxic in the plasma.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: they're autoimmune diseases that build up immune complexes
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable pathophysiological claim about autoimmune disease and plasma immune complexes.

verification_candidates.claim_text: People with overdoses of certain medications would die unless they received apheresis (plasma exchange).
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: they would die unless they got the apheresis done
verification_candidates.rationale: A life-or-death clinical claim about the necessity of apheresis in certain overdoses.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Plasma exchange completely detoxifies digoxin toxicity.
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable claim about the effectiveness of plasma exchange for digoxin toxicity.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Anything toxic that is circulating in plasma can be removed with the plasma exchange machine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: anything that's living in your plasma that is toxic to your system can be removed with this machine
verification_candidates.rationale: A general capability claim about what plasma exchange can remove.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The body regenerates removed plasma components mostly within 24 hours.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: your body is so incredibly good at regenerating those, mostly within twenty four hours
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable physiological claim about the speed of plasma component regeneration.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Growth factors are fully regenerated within 24 hours.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Your growth factors, twenty four hours, yeah, regenerate everything
verification_candidates.rationale: A strong, checkable claim about how quickly growth factors are replaced after plasma exchange.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Immunoglobulins take a little longer to regenerate than other plasma components.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The only thing that takes a little bit longer is immunoglobulins
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable physiological claim about immunoglobulin recovery time.

verification_candidates.claim_text: People at risk for infections are given IVIG (IV immune globulin) after plasma exchange.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: People that are at risk, IVIG, IV immune globulin after the treatment
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable clinical practice claim about IVIG replacement after plasma exchange.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Most other things in plasma, like hormones and growth factors, are replenished within sometimes less than 24 hours.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: most of the other things that circulate in our plasma, like hormones and growth factors, those are replenished within sometimes even less than twenty four hours
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable physiological claim about how quickly most plasma components are replenished.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Progressive overloading of the immune system ('immunofatigue') is a cause of aging.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: general theory emerging about aging called immunofatigue
verification_candidates.rationale: A causal theory of aging with checkable support in the longevity literature.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Immunosenescence (immune aging) is one of the key reasons we age.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: one of the key reasons that we age is immunosenescence and immune aging
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable causal claim about the role of immune aging in human aging.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Humans are burdening their immune systems more than ever before in human civilization.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: we are constantly throwing stuff at our immune system more than we ever have in human civilization
verification_candidates.rationale: A broad comparative claim about immune burden across human history.

verification_candidates.claim_text: There are 150,000 toxins in the environment that were not present eight decades ago.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: there's 150,000 toxins in our environment that were never there just eight decades ago
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific numerical claim about environmental toxins that can be checked against environmental data.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The FDA permits these toxins to be in the food supply.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The FDA lets them all go in our food supply
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable claim about FDA regulatory conduct regarding toxins in food.
